info.title: Loop local fleet administration
info.description: Local paired-device operations. Enrollment-only links are sensitive and returned only by the explicit mint operation. Directory administration stays on its controller; fresh recovery consent chooses a new local lineage. Bodies are bounded to 256 KiB, with 16 active requests and a 60-second deadline.
